visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The opening shot features a white 'kakaii' floor sign and a lush green potted plant in a department store. A wooden display stand behind it holds organized household items under bright, artificial lighting. A person in dark clothing walks past in the distant background. (2) The camera moves closer to a wooden counter showcasing 'Shuanggou' branded aprons and rolling mats. Cartoon character cutouts decorate the top. The products are neatly aligned on light wood surfaces. The department store's modern tiled floor and glass partitions are visible. (3) This phase highlights travel storage solutions. Pink and grey compression bags hang from a black pegboard. A detailed informational poster explains the product features. The bright mall lighting illuminates the fabric textures and hanging tags clearly. (4) Focusing on kitchen items, the camera shows pastel-colored cutting boards and a boxed knife set on a shelf. The scene is clean and organized. In the background, the mall's open atrium and escalators are visible through the glass. (5) The view shifts to a collection of cast iron cookware. Cream and grey pots are displayed alongside their packaging boxes on a low wooden platform. The department store environment is busy with soft-focused shoppers and distant brand signage. (6) A pink display unit features ceramic non-stick pot sets in various sizes. The 'kakaii' logo is prominent on the front of the counter. The wide-angle shot shows the overall booth layout within the spacious, high-ceilinged mall interior. (7) A close-up demonstration shows a pair of hands with white nail polish opening a beige cooling shopping bag. The interior's silver thermal lining is revealed. The background remains the neutral-toned department store shelving area. (8) The final phase shows the hands demonstrating a smaller insulated lunch bag. The camera then cuts back to a wide shot of the entire pop-up store area, inviting viewers with text overlays against the clean mall background.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional walkthrough for a pop-up store for the brand 'kakaii' located at Hsinchu SOGO. By showcasing various categories like kitchenware, travel bags, and character-themed items with upbeat music, it aims to drive foot traffic to the physical location.
